analysis.title: October RCA CRE TRX Held Up, but Tougher Comps to Come
key_insights: Total October 2026 US CRE transaction volumes per RCA were down -51% YoY. Excluding about $25B from the October 2025 Blue Owl/Meta Hyperion data center deal (no CRE broker listed), volumes were down -26% YoY on the initial release.

November/December reports are published at the earliest point in the month, and normal revisions from this point are usually +40% to +55%. GS expects October US CRE volumes ex-data centers to settle at flat to +15% YoY after revisions, consistent with its prior checks.
Data so far is tracking ahead of CRE brokers' 4Q26 expectations of -5% to +4% YoY investment sales/capital markets growth.
October has the easiest YoY comp of 4Q26, since October 2025 was up just +11% YoY, versus +22% in November 2025 and +27% in December 2025.
GS says the impact of recent rises and volatility in the 10-year yield could be felt more later in 4Q, because October closings reflect deals financed and agreed in prior months.
By property type, multifamily was the laggard (-43% YoY) and retail was the only type with growth (+5% YoY). Industrial was down -11% and office down -21%.
Within office, suburban office was down -39% YoY, and CBD office volumes were stronger than suburban.
Absolute monthly volumes improved but remain subdued, particularly versus 2021 and 2022 levels.

sector_views.rationale: October transaction volumes were down on the initial release but are expected to settle flat to +15% YoY ex-data centers after revisions. GS flags tougher comps in November and December and a possible lagged impact from higher 10-year yields.

tension_points.bull_case: October volumes ex-data centers are expected to settle at flat to +15% YoY after the usual +40% to +55% revisions, and data is tracking ahead of brokers' 4Q26 expectations of -5% to +4% YoY.
tension_points.bear_case: Comps get tougher in November (+22% YoY in 2025) and December (+27%), and higher, more volatile 10-year yields could weigh on closings later in 4Q.
tension_points.what_invalidates: November/December 2026 volumes failing to clear the tougher +22% and +27% YoY comps, or closings slowing as 10-year yield volatility feeds through.

theme_stances.key_argument: October volumes held up ex-data centers and should settle flat to +15% YoY after revisions, but tougher comps and higher 10-year yields pose risk later in 4Q.
